Auctioneera is delighted to present 58 The Cloisters.

Located at 58 The Cloisters, Ballincollig, Cork, this attractive semi-detached residence offers a perfect blend of comfort and convenience. The property's façade showcases a classic architectural design with brickwork complemented by a neatly maintained front lawn and a spacious driveway providing ample off-street parking. Sturdy fencing and shrubbery add to the home's privacy and charm.

Inside, you are greeted by a spacious and well-lit entrance hallway, leading to an inviting living room, which features a large window, allowing abundant natural light to warm the space. The living room is further enhanced by a tasteful fireplace that serves as a cosy focal point. Adjacent is an open-plan kitchen and dining area, which boasts modern fittings and expansive work surfaces, ideal for culinary enthusiasts. Sliding doors extend from the dining area to the garden, offering seamless indoor-outdoor living.

The property includes three spacious bedrooms, each with generous-sized windows for natural light. One of the bedrooms includes an ensuite bathroom, adding privacy and convenience. The main bathroom is elegantly designed with contemporary sanitary fittings.

The rear garden is a noteworthy feature, suited for outdoor entertaining or simply enjoying serene evenings. It is well-maintained and provides a great play area for children or pets.

Situated in the heart of Ballincollig, the property benefits from proximity to local schools, sports clubs, and shopping centres, ensuring all amenities are within easy reach. Excellent transport links boost connectivity, with bus stops and main road networks facilitating effortless commuting.

This home is ideal for first-time buyers seeking a comfortable family space or investors looking to expand their portfolio. Its practical layout and strategic location make it a highly appealing choice for those ready to embrace the vibrant community of Ballincollig.
